events.title: GB 9 Aug 2019 disturbance (Hornsea + Little Barford) - measured operating point

losses.what: distributed generation RoCoF-protection trip, 350-430 MW est. (Ofgem 2.4.6; ESO timeline 16:52:34)
additional distributed generation lost at LFDD instant (Ofgem 2.4.13)

recordedActions.what: LFDD stage 1: 892 MW net demand disconnected (Ofgem 2.4.12)

outcome.notes: Ofgem report: RoCoF exceeded 0.125 Hz/s (0.17 per E3C trace); arrest 49.1 Hz at 25 s, plateau 49.2 Hz at 45 s; below 48.8 Hz at ~76 s -> LFDD; 50 Hz within 5 min.

events.notes: Operating point from the record: inertia 215 GVA*s is the NESO recorded outturn for the half-hour containing the 15:52Z onset (Derived/inertia_all_srcs, source=neso_inertia); demand 21147 MW is the WLS-estimated transmission-net national demand for the same period (Derived/estimated_state/gb-spine, chi-square PASS, J=141.0); recorded gross ND for the period was 28112 MW - the difference is embedded generation netted behind the GSPs (high solar afternoon). Estimator evidence at the event sites (estimated bus P injections, MW): Grimsby West (GRIW_1): 1566 (15:00Z) -> 1372 (15:30Z period, onset 15:52Z) -> 755 (16:00Z); Eaton Socon (EASO_1): 609 -> 452 -> -77. Loss sequence and outcome sourced from the Ofgem investigation report '9 August 2019 power outage report' paras 2.4.1-2.4.16 (ofgem.gov.uk, Jan 2020); RoCoF-stage DG loss uses the 350-430 MW estimate's midpoint; LFDD modelled as recorded 892 MW shed plus the ~550 MW concurrent DG loss the report infers from the 350 MW net transmission effect.
